initial_requirements: Military services need a common Tactical Control System for operating different current and future unmanned aerial vehicles and their payloads. Operators should be able to plan and control missions, monitor aircraft and payload status, receive and process sensor information, and distribute imagery and other mission products. The system must also exchange tasking and operational information with the wider command-and-control environment.

turns.interviewer_utterance: What are the primary operational goals and success criteria for this Tactical Control System—such as mission types it must support, priority outcomes, and any capabilities that are most critical to achieve?
turns.interviewee_utterance:
The main goal is to let operators plan, launch, monitor, and recover unmanned aircraft missions reliably across different platforms, without having to use separate systems for each one. It needs to support things like reconnaissance, surveillance, target acquisition, and other ISR-style missions, with the ability to manage the aircraft and its payloads in real time.
Success is mostly about mission effectiveness and responsiveness: operators can get the right sensor data to the right people quickly, maintain situational awareness of the vehicle and payload status, and keep control even when conditions change. The most critical capabilities are common mission planning, live vehicle and payload control, ingesting and processing sensor feeds, and sharing mission products and tasking information with the broader command-and-control environment.

slots.name: project_goals
slots.value: Provide a common Tactical Control System that lets operators reliably plan, launch, monitor, and recover unmanned aircraft missions across multiple platforms without separate systems, supporting ISR missions and enabling effective, responsive mission execution.

slots.name: stakeholder_roles
slots.value: Operators who plan and control missions, monitor aircraft and payload status, process sensor information, and share mission products and tasking information with the broader command-and-control environment.

slots.name: functional_needs
slots.value: Support common mission planning, live vehicle and payload control, real-time monitoring of aircraft and payload status, ingestion and processing of sensor feeds, distribution of imagery and other mission products, and exchange of tasking and operational information with external command-and-control systems.

slots.name: business_rules
slots.value: The system should enable operators to manage missions across different current and future UAV platforms through a common interface, while ensuring mission products and tasking information are shared appropriately with the command-and-control environment.

slots.name: data_entities
slots.value: Unmanned aircraft, payloads, mission plans, sensor feeds, aircraft and payload status information, imagery, mission products, tasking information, and operational information.

slots.name: constraints
slots.value: Must operate across different current and future UAV platforms and their payloads, and must exchange tasking and operational information with the wider command-and-control environment.

slots.name: quality_concerns
slots.value: Reliability, responsiveness, real-time control, situational awareness, and timely distribution of sensor data and mission products.
